title: [LOGGED OUT] Home links and buttons have names for screen readers
reason: 16 of 26 links have no accessible name (logo link, app store badges, 6 social icons, hidden duplicates)

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
steps.saw: Home page loaded, cookie banner shown

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Banner was shown, clicked Dismiss, banner gone

steps.text: Does every link on the page have an accessible name (text, aria-label, title or an image with alt text)?
steps.saw: 26 links in the DOM, 16 have no name (no text, aria-label, title; images have alt=""). Visible ones (10): header logo link (to the home page), App Store, Google Play and Web-Version badges, and 6 footer social links (YouTube, Twitter, TikTok, Discord, Instagram, Facebook). Others are hidden duplicates of the badges and 3 hidden gallery links in a modal.

steps.text: Does every button on the page have an accessible name?
steps.saw: 15 buttons in the DOM. All visible buttons have a name (text). 4 buttons have no name but are all hidden (not displayed): a hidden menu toggle and 3 close/password-toggle icon buttons inside modals. Counting hidden buttons the answer could be No (wording may be too strict, reviewer decides).
